episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: It’s just another luxury Greek holiday for the Tanner family – until their friends’ tutor charms his way into their lives.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Adam is everything the Tanner family needs. When their nanny suddenly falls ill and is rushed to hospital, he sees an opportunity.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Adam moves into the Tanners’ London home and gets to work stoking jealousy and paranoia between Jamie and Nat. But Damian and Jules smell a rat.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Damien discovers that Adam is a fraud. Can Adam stop him before his secrets are revealed?

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Jamie Tanner must fight to save his reputation when Adam accelerates his plans for revenge.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Jamie races to save his family from Adam’s deadly plan.
